news.text: Jim Cramer's top 10 things to watch in the stock market Thursday
Oil markets could enter ‘red zone’ by July as stocks dwindle ahead of summer travel season, IEA chief says
Billionaire families bet on semiconductor and energy stocks in first quarter during Iran war
Traders are making big moves ahead of these earnings reports due Thursday
Jim Cramer says the world of tech investing has changed and it's not going back
Sinkhole shuts runway at LaGuardia Airport, delaying flights, Port Authority warns

brief:
◆ Market Overview

Futures bleeding red across the board with SPY down 0.46% to $737.83 as VIX pops 0.81% to 27.22. Broad-based selling hitting all major indices, but the weakness is measured - not panic selling. Iran tensions and oil supply concerns keeping risk-off sentiment alive.

◆ What to Watch

  • Housing Data Dump - Building permits and housing starts at 12:30 ET could move homebuilders and financials
  • Jobless Claims - Weekly initial claims data will test the employment narrative ahead of month-end
  • Philadelphia Fed Index - Manufacturing sentiment could signal broader economic momentum
  • Oil Supply Dynamics - IEA warning about July "red zone" as Iran controls Hormuz chokepoints

◆ Sector Rotation

Energy (XLE) standing alone with +0.52% gains as oil supply fears dominate headlines. Consumer staples getting hammered down 2.16% - defensive rotation reversing hard. Tech holding up best among growth sectors, down just 0.01%, showing institutional support remains intact.
⚡ Key Driver
Iran consolidating Hormuz control with island checkpoints and "fees" - this is the geopolitical risk premium being priced in real-time
⚠ Bear Case
VIX above 27 with broad sector weakness suggests institutional deleveraging. If housing data disappoints, financials could cascade lower
✦ Bull Case
Samsung strike averted and tech leadership intact. Selloff looks orderly, not capitulation - dip buyers likely emerge on strong economic data

◆ Levels That Matter

  • SPY $735 - Key technical support from April consolidation, break triggers 1-2% flush
  • QQQ $705 - Round number support, holds here and tech bounce likely
  • VIX $30 - Panic threshold, above this level expect accelerated selling
  • XLE $95 - Energy breakout level if oil tensions escalate further

Not a prediction. A preparation. Make your plan before the bell.
